title: Annotations on a Budget: Leveraging Geo-Data Similarity to Balance Model Performance and Annotation Cost

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cosine similarity of visual representations (using CLIP, ALIGN, and BLIP-2) for specific topics/objects across 52 low-resource countries compared to high-resource, predominantly Western datasets (ImageNet, LAION) to identify underrepresented regions, and evaluating how cross-country data augmentation impacts topic classification accuracy.
